terminals.name: theme-dev
terminals.command: if [ -n "$SHOPIFY_CLI_THEME_TOKEN" ]; then npx shopify theme dev --store "${SHOPIFY_FLAG_STORE:-i-correct-final.myshopify.com}"; else echo 'theme-dev not started. Add SHOPIFY_CLI_THEME_TOKEN + SHOPIFY_FLAG_STORE as Cloud Agent secrets to enable live preview of the real theme. See docs/cloud-agent-dev.md'; sleep infinity; fi
